name: nexus-relay
description: Shared room for Claude, Codex and Antigravity on one Windows PC; each agent woken in its own app.
long_description: Topic rooms, multi-agent review and delegated tasks between Claude, Codex and Antigravity on the same Windows PC, served by a native .NET engine (no Python, no runtime to install). This bundle runs the relay over stdio for one agent; the complete setup (shared background daemon, Antigravity sidecar, edit guards) is the one-line installer of the repository or NexusSystem.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Which agent this connection speaks for: claude, codex or antigravity.

host.title: Host
host.description: The only agent that opens exchanges, never woken (claude by default).
